title: China's Factory Activity Returns to Contraction in October as NBS Manufacturing PMI Falls to 49.3
summary: China's official NBS manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October, below the 50-point expansion threshold and missing the consensus estimate of 50.0. The composite PMI also dropped to 49.7, with both manufacturing and non-manufacturing activity contracting simultaneously.
why: 中国制造业与非制造业PMI双双跌破50，为罕见全面收缩信号；周一A股/港股开盘面临抛压，若引发稳增长政策预期可关注估值修复机会；期权策略需警惕短线波动加剧。

title: 美联储10月会议维持利率3.75%-4%，主席沃什：暂停并非见顶，12月加息概率72%
summary: FOMC以10比2投票维持联邦基金利率目标区间3.75%-4%不变，两位反对票（库克、哈马克）主张加息25bp。主席沃什表示暂停是为等待更多数据、并非周期见顶；CME「美联储观察」显示市场定价12月加息25bp概率为72%。
why: 鹰派暂停叠加72%的12月加息预期将继续压制科技股估值；美债收益率维持高位对港股科技股构成压力；Sell Put策略需关注行权价附近的尾部风险，建议回避短期高IV期权卖出。

title: Intel stock has worst day since 1970s, falling 29% as AI spending concerns fuel tech rout
summary: US stocks plunged Friday as disappointing tech earnings fueled AI spending concerns. Intel shares tumbled 29% after weak Q4 guidance, their worst single-day loss since the 1970s. The Nasdaq fell roughly 2.9%, and Alphabet extended its record Thursday loss. Markets are questioning whether massive AI capex investments will deliver returns.
why: 科技股历史性单日暴跌，叠加AI资本支出回报质疑，将压制整体科技板块估值；英伟达等半导体相关标的期权隐含波动率预计大幅升高；持仓需关注相关产品估值重估风险。

title: Hong Kong Stocks Lose a Key Backer as Chinese Investors Head for Exit
summary: Onshore Chinese traders sold a net HK$24 billion ($3.1 billion) of Hong Kong shares through the Stock Connect trading link in October through Thursday, which would be the biggest monthly southbound outflow since 2021. The Hang Seng has fallen more than 12% this year despite state-backed ETF buying.
why: 南向资金创2021年来最大月度净流出，显示内地投资者对港股信心不足；结合美联储鹰派姿态与科技股暴跌，港股短期内面临多重压力；看涨期权时间价值加速衰减，Sell Put需谨慎。

title: Alibaba wins preliminary injunction against Pentagon contract restrictions tied to China blacklist
summary: A US federal judge in San Jose granted Alibaba a preliminary injunction, blocking the Pentagon from denying contracts to companies because they do business with Alibaba's lobbying partners. Judge Eumi K. Lee found Alibaba likely to succeed on free-speech grounds. The Chinese military designation itself remains in place as the case continues.
why: 延续报道：2026-06起诉五角大楼的阶段性进展，法院初步禁令可减轻承包商合规压力，对阿里巴巴企业云/政府合同业务构成利好；但军事名单尚存、最终判决未出，不宜过度解读；期权隐含波动率短期内可能因此小幅回落。
